title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
summary: Hold: the briefing leaves the pay-as-you-go requirement for next best actions open, but Microsoft's Next best action for case reference explicitly requires that plan. The roadmap facts and listed control operations are supported; the profile-selection instructions and checklist need small corrections.
